study: Own-rules platinum validation: families and pools

budget.rule: setup or tested condition <= 2 optimized inputs and <= 25 iterations; everything else in panes 1-2 pinned; each pane-4 exit <= 1 optimized input and <= 4 values; worst = 25 x 4

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 148 -> ~10 at default (5/30); strength 4 / anchor 20 corner looser (~15-20), 6/40 corner ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: Bounce off the most recently hit side of a swing box (failed small swing short of that side): a range-edge fade. Grid spans the note's Y 20-40 and strength 4-6 (note X 5-7, leaned one step loose). touchTolAtr is ATR-relative, pinned 0 (exact touch, the authored default; harmless). innerStrength pinned at the note's 2-bar swing.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 9 -> ~0.6 at default; looser corner (3/20) maybe ~3-5; plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: Fades the first break of the first inner pivot of a live swing box (buy the first undercut of an inner swing low): range fade, authored long is the setup. Strength leaned below the note's 5-7 because the default is very rare; anchorLookback on the note's 20-40.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 7 -> ~0.5 at default; looser corner (3 / 1 ATR) maybe ~3-5; plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: False break below an inner box inside a swing box, then close back above: range fade. minBoxAtr 1..3 keeps the default 3 as the selective end; anchorLookback pinned at the note's looser 20 (default 30) to help a very rare rule.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 8 -> ~0.6 at default (7/0.25); looser corner (3/0.75) maybe ~5; plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: Break of a double-swing level, retest back through it, then resumption: a breakout continuation. Note's 7-bar swing kept as the selective end; ATR level tolerance widened. maxBarsAfterBreak pinned at the note's 5.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 6 -> ~0.4 at default; looser corner (0.75 / 0.5) maybe ~2-3; plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: Undercut-and-reclaim of the swing low beneath a level pair (a spring): failed-breakdown fade. Default tolerance at the tight end, minBelowAtr centred on its default 1. Strength pinned 2 (note gives none).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 14 -> ~1 at default (3/2); looser corner (2/1) maybe ~4-6; selective corner (3/3) plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: Support break, retests from below, then reclaim: a failed-breakdown fade. Touch counts span one step looser to one step tighter than the note; tolAtr pinned 0.25 (default 0.15) to loosen; closeMarginAtr pinned 0 = the note's 'no closes below' (ATR-relative, harmless).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 74 -> ~5 at default; zoneSize 2 / run 15 corner maybe ~10; zoneSize 4 / run 5 corner ~1-2
setupFamilies.rationale: Fade a one-colour run that slices through two stacked I2 support zones: reversal. Grid centred on the defaults; pivotLookback pinned 150 (default 100) so more zone pairs are found, reach still 165.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 149 -> ~10 at default (strength 2); strength 1 ~2-3x more, strength 3 ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: First close out of an L-H-L-H contracting pivot box: breakout (the p.60 fade is the reverse group). Only strength is a real knob; lookback just has to hold four pivots.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 274 -> ~19 at default (2/2); 3/3 corner maybe ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: Fade a pivot that arrives late against the recent pivot rhythm: reversal. lateMultiple spans the note's '2-3x'. lookback pinned 200 (default 300 would need Max Bars Back 500); 200 bars still hold 9 pivots plus a late gap at strength 3.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 655 -> ~45 at default; strength 4 maybe ~20
setupFamilies.rationale: Pivot type order low-high-high (two highs without a low between): upside continuation. Frequent at default, so the grid runs from the default toward fewer, bigger pivots.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 977 -> ~68 at default; strength 4 maybe ~30
setupFamilies.rationale: Second leg of an H-L-H-L sequence falls slower per bar than the first: downside momentum fading, long. Authored long is the fade the note names (its short mirrored), so not flipped.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 236 -> ~16 at default (4/0.5); 3/0.8 corner ~25, 5/0.4 corner ~6
setupFamilies.rationale: A new pivot extreme followed by a contracting pullback inside the move: continuation. Strength pinned at Brian's 3; Q and R gridded around the defaults (R 0.4 tighter than the 0.5 default).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 528 -> ~37 at default (3/0.8); selective corner 4/0.9 perhaps ~15-20
setupFamilies.rationale: The long breaks a falling fractal-high line, trading against the prior down leg, so the trend condition goes flipped (long in a downtrend). SwingRegressionTrend as authored contradicts the falling line and flipped it largely duplicates it. Grid: pivotCount 3-4 (the note's '3 or more'), R^2 floor 0.6-0.9 around the 0.8 default; slope, age and lookback pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 20 -> ~1.4 at default; looser grid (breakTol = Y, tol 0.5-1.0, strength 1) guess ~5-15; strength 2 / tol 0.5 corner still rare
setupFamilies.rationale: Very rare at default: three highs within 0.25 ATR, and breakTol 0.25 < Y 0.5 means one close must jump the whole band. breakTol pinned = Y so it fires on the first close Y ATR clear; tol widened to 0.5-1.0; strength 1-2 is the note's '3 bar, 5 bar'. M 3 as the note.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 1042 alone -> ~72; with HigherSwingLow roughly half, ~30-40 at centre; corner 0.15/0.45 perhaps ~15
setupFamilies.rationale: Cluster: the note (P13) is 'a swing low, then a higher swing low; a bar rejects off the second', and the CATALOG row says the higher-low context is HigherSwingLow placed separately, so it is pinned at the same strength 2 / maxBarsBack 60. Buying the test of a higher low is a with-trend pullback. tol and wick fraction centred on the defaults.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 38 -> ~2.6 at default (0.05/1.0); looser corner 0.3/0.5 guess ~15-20; selective corner 0.1/1.0 ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: Fires once per confirmed pivot and the 0.05 ATR level pair is very tight, so the grid leans loose: eqAtr 0.1-0.3 (note: '.05 ATR or something'), breakAtr 0.5-1.0 (note: 1 ATR). strength 2 and ATR 10 are the note's.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 44 -> ~3 at default (3 bars, 2 ATR); 3/1.5 guess ~8; corner 5/2.0 ~1
setupFamilies.rationale: Continuation: long on a tight pause holding at a large bull bar's high. pauseBars 3-5 is the note's range; minRangeAtr eased to 1.5-2.0 because the ON-12-a shape (2 ATR, quarter open/close) is rare. Band and small-bar fractions are the note's.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 72 -> ~5 at default (5 bars, 2 ATR); looser corner 3/1.5 guess ~15; corner 5/2.0 ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: Authored long: a large bear bar's follow-through stalls, then the first close back above its midpoint, a failure of the bar, so reversal. minHoldBars 3-5 (note: at least 5) and minRangeAtr 1.5-2.0 lean loose; extension 0.5 and the 30-bar anchor scan pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 126 -> ~9 at default (1.5 ATR, 20 bars); looser corner 1.0/10 guess ~25; corner 1.5/30 ~7
setupFamilies.rationale: Authored long: a large bull bar at the 20-bar high, then a higher high closing strong, a momentum continuation at a new extreme. minRangeAtr 1.0-1.5 (note >1.5) leans loose; the window is the note's 20, gridded 10-30; closeZone 20% and nearAtr pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 43 -> ~3 at default (2 ATR, quarter shapes, 20); with nearFraction 0.333 and 1.5 ATR guess ~10; corner 2.0/30 ~3
setupFamilies.rationale: Authored long: huge bull breakout bar, a bearish inside-bar pullback that never takes its low, then the first green bar, a with-trend resumption. nearFraction (used for both the huge bar and the inside bar) pinned at 1/3 rather than 1/4 to loosen; hugeAtr 1.5-2.0 and breakLookback 10-30 (note: X 10-50).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 23 -> ~1.6 at default (2 bars, 1 ATR); 1/0.5 guess ~15; corner 3/1.0 ~1
setupFamilies.rationale: Authored long: a large bull mother bar, an inside run, then a close above its high, a box breakout (the note's .4, the bear pattern traded long, is the reverse). Very rare at default, so containedBars 1-3 (note 1-4) and minRangeAtr 0.5-1.0 (note >1) both lean loose. The trend context is pane 2, per the row.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 370 -> ~26 at default (25 x 2); corner 40 x 3 guess ~12
setupFamilies.rationale: Long buys a new short-window low that holds above the longer low, a pullback inside the larger move, so as-authored trend (in a downtrend a new short low is usually also a new long low). NewExtremeFrequency long (many recent new highs) leaves little room for a new 20-40 bar low. longFactor on whole numbers 2-3 as required.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 281 -> ~20 at default (12, 0.6); corner 14/0.7 guess ~12
setupFamilies.rationale: Counter-trend long after a strong bear bar whose top half stays untouched for W bars; the authored long is the named setup, so setupFlipped false. W 10-14 is the note's ~10-15, body fraction 0.5-0.7 around 0.6; K 1 ATR is the note's. The paired exit TargetAtSignalBarOpen is not gridded here.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 0 at default (k 1.0, f 0.25); looser grid unmeasured, guess ~5-15 at 0.5/0.5, corner 1.0/0.3 near 0
setupFamilies.rationale: Zero fires at default: two consecutive bull bars each >= 1 ATR, then 3-5 bars that never leave the top quarter of the move. k eased to 0.5-1.0 and the pullback band f to 0.3-0.5 (the note says top 20-30%, so 0.4-0.5 goes past it); run and pullback lengths are the note's. Highest risk in part B.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 1005 -> ~70 at default (7, 0.5); corner 9/0.4 guess ~40
setupFamilies.rationale: Authored long: an X-bar low, then an X-bar high, then the first close back into the bottom Y of that high bar, buying the pullback after an up swing. X 5-9 is the note's 5-10, Y 0.4-0.6 around ~50%; maxWaitBars pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 191 -> ~13 at default (20); N 10 guess ~30, N 30 ~8
setupFamilies.rationale: Fades an outsized bar spanning from beyond the midline through the channel edge. N is the only knob (note: 20), so it gets 5 values 10-30; the optional size floor stays off as authored.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 417 -> ~29 at default (20); X 10 guess ~45, X 30 ~22
setupFamilies.rationale: Single-input breakout; X gets 5 values centred on the default 20.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 330 bare (no zone gate) -> ~23; with the zone gate est ~5-10 at centre; tight corner (0.75 ATR margin, 3 ATR zone) ~2-3
setupFamilies.rationale: The rule does not inline the zone, so it is clustered with RangeWidthBelowAtrMultiple at lag 1 with rangeLookback = atrLookback = zoneBars (slice 05). zoneBars is pinned at 15 (the looser end of the note's 15-40) because it must match across both placements. RangeWidthBelowAtrMultiple is same-sided, so the reverse flips only ConsolidationBreakoutBar (= #31's failed-breakout short).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 6 at default (20/3/0.5/10) -> ~0.4; loosened grid est ~1-2 at the 20/3 corner, ~5-10 at 10/5. Plainly rare
setupFamilies.rationale: The zone is inlined (composes ON-30-a + ON-30-b). The defaults are near-silent, so every lever is pulled loose: the breakout margin is pinned at the note's low end 0.25, the wait is doubled to 20, and the grid spends on the two levers that most change the breakout rate (a shorter zone, a wider zone multiple).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 15 at default -> ~1; loosened grid est ~3 at 20/3, ~10-15 at 10/5. Rare
setupFamilies.rationale: The zone is inlined. Same loosening as FirstRetest. maxWaitBars stays at 10 because the first close above the breakout bar's high normally comes within a few bars.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 29 at lookback 50 -> ~2; lookback 10-30 makes breakout candles several times commoner, est ~5-15 at centre; the 30/minC 2 corner is rare
setupFamilies.rationale: H-C..C-H continuation with an unbroken C run (Brian 2026-11-05). The 50-bar default is nearly silent on daily bars, so the window is pulled to 10-30. maxSpan is pinned at 20: a run of 20 consecutive C bars is implausible, so it does not bind, and it keeps the reach at 50.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 331 -> ~23 at default; a persistent state, so flips fall slowly with breakoutBars/eventCount
setupFamilies.rationale: maxScanBars is cut from 300 to 220 so the reach (maxScanBars + breakoutBars - 1) is 249 at breakoutBars 30 and Max Bars Back stays 250. minShare is pinned at 0.8 (4/5, 6/7, 8/9); 1.0 would duplicate ConsecutiveUpsideBreakouts. NewExtremeFrequency counts the same breakout events.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 407 -> ~28 at default (20/3)
setupFamilies.rationale: maxScanBars is cut to 220 for the same reason (reach 249). The event count is 2-4, around the note's 3.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 0 at default (40-60 held 50 bars). Est ~3-10 at 15/20; the 15/30 corner is rare. Count risk high
setupFamilies.rationale: The default never fires: RSI held inside 40-60 for 50 bars almost never happens. The grid uses the note's wider bands (35-65, 30-70) and a 10-30 bar hold; the note's 50-bar hold is left out as the silent edge. Long = buy the first green bar after an oversold break, which is a fade.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 218 -> ~15 at default (5/5); 5/7 corner est ~8
setupFamilies.rationale: RSI compresses around 50, then the signal bar's colour gives the side: a volatility-breakout read. Both of the note's bands (45-55, 40-60), with a hold of 3-7 bars around its 'at least 5'. ADX above 25 contradicts RSI pinned near 50.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 515 -> ~36 at default
setupFamilies.rationale: A bullish divergence at a fresh window low, so a reversal. One knob, 5 values over the note's 5-30 range; RSI 14 is pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 2700 -> ~190 (a state that flips often)
setupFamilies.rationale: Long = price fell while ADX fell: a fade of a weakening move. compareBars spans the note's 5-30; ADX 14 is pinned. The ADX level filters do not contradict a fall in ADX.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 165 -> ~11 at 20; est ~20 at 10, ~5 at 40
setupFamilies.rationale: One knob; the reach is 4 x stepBars = 160 at the stop. The 50 at the top of the note's range is dropped (reach 200, and rarer). DaveyMomentum is the ladder's own first link at another horizon, a near-duplicate.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 460 -> ~32 at default
setupFamilies.rationale: The band width and the episode window are the selectivity knobs; length 20 is pinned (Bollinger convention).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 484 -> ~34 at default
setupFamilies.rationale: The band width and the expiry (which the note leaves open) are the knobs; length 20 is pinned.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 792 -> ~55 at default (middle band); the lower-band half est ~10-20
setupFamilies.rationale: Middle line only (Brian, 2026-11-06: option c; price passes the middle line before the lower, so 'whichever first' is the middle). maxWaitBars back at the rule default 15. A pullback in a band-confirmed trend, so with-trend.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 189 -> ~13 at default; runBars 2 corner ~20, runBars 4 corner ~8
setupFamilies.rationale: Whole bars above a slow EMA still in bearish order = price breaking out of a downtrend before the MAs turn. runBars is the note's 2-4; slowLength 50/75/100 varies how stale the bearish order is. FastEmaAboveSlowEma (authored) is the exact negation of the setup's MA-order test.

setupFamilies.estM1440: DoubleEmaTouchRun alone (same-sided) smoke 1130 -> ~78; with the flipped MA-order placement roughly half the touch runs, ~30-40 at runBars 3, ~15 at runBars 5
setupFamilies.rationale: Note #39 / CATALOG row: DoubleEmaTouchRun gives no direction, so the setup is [DoubleEmaTouchRun, FastEmaAboveSlowEma flipped] = long when bars straddle both EMAs while EMA25 < EMA50 (reversal). EMA lengths are pinned 25/50 in BOTH placements so they describe the same averages (a template cannot tie two optimized inputs); only runBars (note's 3-5) is optimized. FastEmaAboveSlowEma in pane 2 duplicates the cluster's own placement. MaStackGapNarrowing must go in AUTHORED (its long side is fast<slow, consistent); flipped it would contradict. MaWickTouchesHoldSide (EMA50) will pass rarely here because straddling run bars reset its count.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 69 -> ~5 at default (= the tight corner 1.0/0.25); loose corner 0.5/0.75 perhaps ~20-30
setupFamilies.rationale: Price has lived well above the EMA and come back to it: a pullback in an established trend. Defaults are rare, so the grid leans loose from the default corner (minLongAtr down to 0.5, maxShortAtr up to 0.75). Lengths pinned at the note's reading.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 129 -> ~9 at default (200/3, the tight corner); loose corner 100/1.5 perhaps ~25
setupFamilies.rationale: Trades THROUGH the long EMA after an unusually long absence, expecting it not to hold: a breakout. Default is rare-ish, so gapMultiple leans loose (1.5-3) and the EMA shortens to 100 for more touches. maxScanBars pinned 500 -> Max Bars Back 500 (the brief's known case).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 1157 -> ~80 at default (a state; count ~ side changes); 2.0 corner well under half that
setupFamilies.rationale: Close beyond a body-average band = breakout. Both knobs centred on the defaults 20/1.5 (bandLength 10/30/50). Frequent, so no need to loosen.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 198 -> ~14 at default (3/10); 2/5 corner ~25+, 4/15 corner ~6-8
setupFamilies.rationale: Price flips to and holds the other side of the EMA after a longer spell = a breakout through the average. priorBars >= 5 > recentBars <= 4 keeps the note's Y > X everywhere. With FastEmaAboveSlowEma (authored) the joint rate is low, since EMA25 usually still lags below EMA50 at the flip, but it is not contradictory.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 189 -> ~13 at default (5/0.6); loose corner 3/0.5 ~25, tight 7/0.7 ~5
setupFamilies.rationale: Fade at a level whose past visits were wick rejections (short at rejected-from-above, long at rejected-from-below): range edge fade. Authored long is support holding, not flipped. LevelBodyDominated is the strict complement of the wick classes (body >= 0.6 leaves wicks <= 0.4) so it never co-fires at the 0.5-0.7 grid.

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 886 -> ~60 at default (10/0.5); tight 15/1.5 corner perhaps ~10
setupFamilies.rationale: Long where past visits were followed by up moves: the level's historical reaction, read as support/resistance (range). horizon stop 15 < minGap 20 so every visit stays forward-complete. Frequent at default, so driftAtr leans tighter (0.5-1.5).

setupFamilies.estM1440: smoke 618 -> ~43 at default (2/10); maxVisits 0 corner ~20-30
setupFamilies.rationale: Price in thin air, entered with momentum: a breakout into untraded territory. The four Level* regime conditions need >= 5 visits while this setup needs <= 4, so they never co-fire (negated, they pass trivially and duplicate it).

conditionFamilies.rationale: Both strength-1 swing-high and swing-low regression lines rising at least s ATR/bar is an uptrend, mirrored. X 4-8 pivots per line (the default 4 is not in the note), slope floor 0-0.1 ATR/bar; 8 strength-1 pivots fit easily in the 100-bar scan.

Higher highs and higher lows of strength-N pivots, mirrored. The note's 30 bars per side is the centre, gridded 20-40 (one input). maxBarsBack 400 holds two pivots of each kind; reach maxBarsBack-1+strength is 429 pinned and 439 at stop, so Max Bars Back 500, including every pane-1 family that draws it pinned.
The long side counts new highs, so it confirms an uptrend: trend. Pinned one notch looser than the default 0.3 to land in the useful pass band.

A trend-bar regime, negated for consolidation bars. Pinned at the note's X = 1 rather than the centre 2, since 'outside the previous bar' is the note's own reading. 0.4 replaces the default 0.5 (est ~15-20%) to reach a sensible pass share.
lag 1 per the slice notes (the N bars ENDING ONE BAR AGO, 'before the signal bar'; slice default lag 1, CATALOG 'lookback 10, lag 1'). lookback 10 is the note's ~10.
A steady-volatility regime, negated for erratic volatility. The default is the centre.
A low-volatility (squeeze) regime. Pinned at the grid centre 20/100 rather than the default 50. The reach is 149 at the stop.
Classic MA order. Pinned at the note's 25/50 (inside the grid, slow at the grid's low end) so the pane-2 placement matches the DoubleEmaTouchRun cluster's averages; familyGrid centre is 25/75.
Confirmed from the code: long = fast < slow, both falling over narrowLookback, gap narrowing - a downtrend losing steam, so reversal-context. Place it AUTHORED under reversal setups.
The EMA holding as support (long) / resistance (short): a trend confirmation. Pinned touchCount 2 rather than the default 3 to keep the pass rate in range.
Same-sided level character; family pane 2 = it | it negated. lookback 500 -> Max Bars Back 500 (known Level* case).
Mean ADX at the visit bars; threshold spans the 20/25/30 regime boundary. ADX length pinned at 14.

Centred at 1.0 for the same reason as LevelBigBars; volumeLookback pinned at 50.

classicFilters.note: close above the close 50 bars ago; Davey momentum, pane 2 only (Brian)

trend.note: high at or above the 20-bar high

meanReversion.note: close crosses back over the lower 20/2 Bollinger band (EEC E25's term)
close crosses back over the lower 20/2 Keltner band (EEC E26's term)

stopPool.note: the Davey families' catastrophic stop, same value

drawConstraints.pane2NotInSetup: a pane-2 condition may not use a rule already placed in the family's pane 1
drawConstraints.pane2Conflicts: a setup's pane2Conflicts are never drawn into its pane 2
drawConstraints.orientation: trend conditions as authored for with-trend/breakout setups, flipped for reversal/range; reversal-context conditions the other way round
drawConstraints.intradayCap: at most 1 intraday-only member across panes 3+4 and at most 1 intraday-effective switch per family
drawConstraints.switchKinds: at most one equity-profit and at most one equity-loss switch per family
drawConstraints.classicEntries: pane-2 families: one trend-following and one mean-reversion classic entry
drawConstraints.balance: least-used-first per pool with seeded random tie-breaks; the best of 200 seeded attempts by total count spread is kept
